pronunciation: in · dih · FAT · ih · guh · bul
definition: Continuing to work with great energy and without tiring.
author: Mary Shelley
quote: He was respected by all who knew him for his integrity and indefatigable attention to public business.
example_sentence: Our indefatigable neighbour has mown his lawn three times this week.
